**Test image analysis:**
- Sugarcane plant with severely bleached/straw-colored leaves
- Distinct longitudinal striping pattern along leaf blades (alternating green and cream/white)
- Reddish-pink discoloration at the plant base/crown
- Overall severe chlorosis with some leaves completely dried

Key candidates: **Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv** (linear stripe pattern), **Leaf_Scald** (straw-colored lesions), **Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus** (mosaic pattern). Let me view one reference per class.

The reference image paths aren't accessible on this system. I'll make my classification based on careful analysis of the test image alone.

**Detailed test image analysis:**

1. **Plant part affected**: Whole plant canopy - leaves and stem base
2. **Leaf symptoms**:
   - Extensive straw/cream/white bleaching covering most of the leaf surface
   - Distinct longitudinal striping pattern - alternating green and cream/white bands running parallel to the leaf veins
   - Multiple leaves completely dried/straw-colored
   - Some leaves showing thin parallel cream stripes on green background
3. **Stem/base symptoms**: Reddish-pink discoloration visible at the crown/base area
4. **Severity**: Severe - most of the plant canopy is affected

**Disease matching reasoning:**

- **Leaf_Scald** (Xanthomonas albilineans): Causes white/cream pencil-thin stripes running parallel to veins; in severe cases entire leaves become straw-colored ("scalded"); can show reddish stem discoloration → matches the fine parallel white stripes and severe straw bleaching
- **Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv**: Causes broader streaks/mosaic of pale-green to yellow running along veins, progressive yellowing → the longitudinal striping could fit
- **Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus**: More irregular mosaic/mottling pattern, less of the severe bleaching seen here → less likely

The dominant pattern of **thin parallel white stripes running the full leaf length combined with severe straw-colored scalding of the entire canopy** and reddish stem discoloration is most consistent with advanced **Leaf_Scald**.
